confidence_rationale: Authoritative mechanistic review establishing the reciprocal M4-dopamine relationship (from M4-knockout work) and the dual M1/M4 rationale: M4 confers antidopaminergic / antipsychotic-like activity while M1/M4 together also drive pro-cognitive effects. Directly grounds the layer's two-plane interaction framing (M4=dopamine-selection, M1=plasticity/cognition). Confidence mid-range because it is a review (some claims preclinical-model-level) and the M1-vs-M4 functional partition is presented as a rationale, not a fully isolated result.
failure_signatures: The review notes that schizophrenia is a syndrome and muscarinic agonists, like D2 antagonists, will not help everyone -- non-response may track cortical M1 deficits; this predicts heterogeneity the REE single-mechanism plane story does not capture.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Postmortem and imaging studies show decreased M1 and M4 receptors in schizophrenia-relevant regions; M4-knockout work reveals a reciprocal relationship between M4 and dopamine-receptor function; muscarinic agonists show antidopaminergic activity in assays predictive of antipsychotic efficacy; and the M1/M4-preferring partial agonist xanomeline has antipsychotic-like and pro-cognitive activity preclinically and reduces psychotic symptoms clinically. An agonist engaging both M1 and M4 is proposed to address core symptom clusters.
mapping.ree_translation: The layer's Section 3B asserts a two-plane interaction: M4 dampens the MECH-086 dopamine trajectory-selection gain (antidopaminergic, antipsychotic) while M1 acts on the cortical plasticity/encoding plane (cognition). McKinzie & Bymaster ground exactly this partition -- the reciprocal M4-dopamine relationship is the dopamine-selection arm, and the M1/M4 pro-cognitive rationale is the second plane -- and they tie it to MECH-088 psychosis via the antidopaminergic-without-D2 mechanism.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a review synthesising preclinical-model and postmortem data; the M1-vs-M4 functional split is a well-argued rationale rather than a cleanly isolated causal dissociation, and 'antidopaminergic activity in predictive assays' is a behavioural proxy, not a direct measure of REE's trajectory-selection gain.
mapping.source_context: Mixed human postmortem/imaging + rodent knockout + behavioural-predictive assays; narrative mechanistic review.

confidence_components.notes: Authoritative review by the original xanomeline-mechanism investigators. Mapping_fidelity moderate-good for the M4-dopamine / M1-cognition two-plane framing; the limiter is review-level evidence and proxy endpoints. Transfer risk moderate.
